 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Mridul Kumar Kalita
 Order
Date : 07.04.2026
1. Heard Mr. K. K. Bhatta, learned counsel for the appellant.

2. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the appellant impugning the judgment and award dated 18.12.2025 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Goalpara, in MAC Case No. 312/2018 whereby the appellant was directed to pay a compensation amount of Rs.7,61,200/- along with an interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum to the claimant/respondent.
3. I have gone through the grounds taken in the memo of appeal and have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant.

5. Issue notice to the respondents.
6. Let the records of MAC Case No. 312/2018 be called for from the concerned tribunal.
7.
The Registry shall take steps for requisitioning the records.
8. The appellant shall take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable 22nd of May, 2026.
